subject: New analysis tool for seabird at-sea data

messages.author: 837542691cff34af
messages.subject: New analysis tool for seabird at-sea data
parts:
Hi guys,

A quick note to mention our R package GeoAviR and web app GeoAviRWeb for the computation of seabird at-sea densities. This initiative is from the Canadian Wildlife Service and Université du Québec à Rimouski. This tool originally has been built for our continuously growing seabird at-sea database in eastern Canada and compute densities by species in one run. Since there is no restriction on access, any user can import his own data and do line-transect or strip-transect analyses for data collected using binned distances. You can access our web app and R package at GeoAviRWeb.ddns.net. We also have a google group: https://groups.google.com/d/forum/geoavir



François Bolduc
